signature.name: VTask.SumEval
signature.type:
{I : Type u} -> (C : Set (I → Bool)) -> [LinearOrder I] -> [WellFoundedLT I] -> {o : Ordinal.{u}} -> (ho : o < Ordinal.type fun x1 x2 => x1 < x2) -> ↑(Profinite.NobelingProof.GoodProducts (Profinite.NobelingProof.π C fun x => Profinite.NobelingProof.ord I x < o)) ⊕
      ↑(Profinite.NobelingProof.GoodProducts.MaxProducts C ho) →
    LocallyConstant ↑C ℤ

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on a well-typed coproduct input with no junk values or special boundary conventions.

facts.statement: ∀ {I : Type} [LinearOrder I] [WellFoundedLT I] (C : Set (I → Bool)) {o : Ordinal} (ho : o < Ordinal.type (· < ·)), VTask.SumEval C ho ∘ Sum.inl = ModuleCat.ofHom (Profinite.NobelingProof.πs C o) ∘ Profinite.NobelingProof.GoodProducts.eval (Profinite.NobelingProof.π C fun x => Profinite.NobelingProof.ord I x < o)
